europe_now.title: Spain imposes border controls on Italy amid Ceuta migrant tensions
europe_now.summary: Spain has introduced border checks on travelers from Italy due to rising migrant arrivals in Ceuta. Italy has rejected the move, calling it unilateral and unjustified.

europe_now.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign defence pact
europe_now.summary: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have signed a mutual defence agreement committing to treat an attack on one as an attack on all. The pact aims to strengthen regional security cooperation.

top_stories.title: EU ministers leave Global Gateway board seats empty despite transparency calls
top_stories.summary: EU member states have not filled key seats on the Global Gateway investment board, despite criticism over lack of transparency. The vacancies delay strategic infrastructure projects in partner countries.

europe_now.summary: Spain has imposed border checks on travelers from Italy in response to increased migrant crossings at Ceuta. The move has escalated tensions between Spain and Italy, with Spain threatening reciprocal measures and Italy rejecting the ultimatum.
